{{Quote|We opened up Echo Base in record time.|Kem Monnon, after successfully constructing Echo Base|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />}}
'''Kem Monnon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]] before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he had become a [[Major/Legends|major]] and the [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]]. In that year, Monnon was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], leading the Alliance Corps of Engineers when they were assigned to construct a base for the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].

Monnon reported to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], deeply respecting the latter and ensuring the other [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] maintained the same respect for the general. The group had also modified [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] for optimal performance in Hoth's [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] weather and domesticated the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for use as mounts. The subsequent [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] headquarters had ultimately taken eighteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]] to carve out and two more to fit it with electronics, [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and [[Life support/Legends|life support]]. Monnon would later write a report about Hoth and his [[Time/Legends|time]] constructing Echo Base.

==Biography==
===Tramp freighters and finding an Alliance base===
{{Quote|Tactically insignificant, ''[Hoth is]'' unnoticed by the Imperial Navy. A perfect hiding place for a Rebel base.|Kem Monnon, on Hoth being a viable base for the Alliance|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />}}
[[File:Kem_Helmet.png|thumb|left|200px|Kem Monnon, Alliance Corps of Engineers chief]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]], Kem Monnon spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]]. He joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. By that year,<ref name="date">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|10|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}} states the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]] was tasked with constructing [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the latter event to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Monnon was a [[Major/Legends|major]] and led the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]] as [[Chief/Legends|chief]].<ref name="Starships">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|10|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> When the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] was searching for a headquarters<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />&mdash;as their previous headquarters, the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], had been [[Evacuation of Yavin|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>&mdash;Monnon offered his own suggestions, particularly emphasizing the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after he had learned direct and anecdotal information from his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the tramp [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

Hoth was ultimately where the Alliance decided to construct a base, with Monnon reporting to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and being responsible for establishing the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] headquarters on the planet<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> in 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="date" /> Initially, the [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] sent a reconnaissance and survey team in a low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Map/Legends|mapping]] expedition to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for possible locations. Following the group's discovery of a series of ice [[Cave/Legends|caverns]], Monnon knew that they had discovered the Alliance's headquarters. Mapping was subsequently completed before construction would commence.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> Included among the discovered caves were the remains of facilities once used by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Salmakk]],<ref name="Javin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref> as well as caverns used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="Starships" />

====Constructing Echo Base====
{{Quote|The first major part of the work of constructing Echo Base involved expansion of the natural ice caves.|Monnon discusses the first phase of Echo Base's construction|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />}}
[[File:Hoth_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Hoth, where Monnon would construct Echo Base]]
The first part of Monnon's work involved expanding the ice caves. Upon arriving on the planet, some of his engineers tried the meat of Hoth's [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] [[Species/Legends|species]], ultimately finding the meat not good. Monnon thus knew that, for the foreseeable future, he and his group would continue only to be eating [[Ration pack/Legends|pre-packaged rations]]. The engineers used excavator machinery and [[Laser cutter/Legends|laser cutters]] to blast grottoes and install connections between chambers while power conduits and communications tubes ran along the walls.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> Other equipment used included mechanical [[Drill/Legends|drills]] and [[vibrospade]]s,<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|echobase|Echo Base}}</ref> along with heavy materials such as [[gravitonic lifter]]s and [[massdroid]]s to excavate and expand the ice and snow within the caves.<ref name="Javin" />

Large chambers became equipment rooms and [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, with machinery, including the base's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], located outside under thick layers of insulation. While Monnon and the engineers needed to maintain Echo Base at freezing [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]], insulating [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] coated the walls and allowed for rooms to be heated at comfortable temperatures. At certain points, drastic meltdowns occurred when well-meaning [[Droid/Legends|droids]] increased certain rooms' temperatures upon overhearing complaints about the cold. Monnon also made sure that all the Alliance Corps of Engineers knew Rieekan's history&mdash;that the general's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]&mdash;and would not tolerate any of them complaining about Rieekan being unreasonable or paranoid about being discovered or attacked. The base was ultimately built with quarters and accommodations for several thousand people, including the Alliance government.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

===Life on Hoth===
{{Quote|The ice planet seemed a terrible option, a horrendously difficult place to establish living quarters&hellip; but it was also a place where the Empire would never suspect us.|Monnon, about his choice and the living conditions on Hoth|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />}}
[[File:CormanQuien-CCG.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Corporal Corman Quien, who worked with tauntauns while reporting to Monnon]]
Although life was not easy for Monnon and the engineers on Hoth, individuals found ways to enjoy themselves. As [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor impacts]] created circular craters on the planet's surface, off-duty engineers would go ice-skating on the frozen lakes that formed atop those craters. They also had domesticated tauntauns, with the creatures proving invaluable for certain activities, for reasons such as the engineers being unable to fix their machinery's cold weather malfunctions.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> As the Alliance's [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] were difficult to adopt on the planet, [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Corman Quien]], who was charged with capturing, taming, and training native creatures as mounts, was assigned to work for Monnon, herding the tauntauns. Another Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officer]], Major [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], worked with Monnon's engineers as a supervisor.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref>

The tauntauns were also used as a form of entertainment for new Alliance scouts. Certain new members would put together "tauntaun rodeos" in Hoth's snowfields, performing stunt activities while riding the creatures. Monnon's distaste for the tauntauns was such that he once gave an engineer a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of outside perimeter inspections as punishment for the latter stating a co-worker smelled like a tauntaun as an insult.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

===Exploring Hoth===
{{Quote|The stark, hostile landscape of Hoth may seem terrifying to many life-forms, but the frozen scenery has its own sort of beauty.|Monnon, about the planet that he would proceed to explore|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />}}
[[File:WampaAttacksTauntaun-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A wampa, one of Hoth's predators that Monnon was aware of, attacking a tauntaun, the latter species being adopted by Monnon at Echo Base]]
The Alliance Corps of Engineers' job was considered done after Echo Base was open for habitation and the primary routine was established. However, Monnon spoke to Rieekan, who gave the former permission to continue exploring Hoth and to compile a report for further strategic use by the Alliance. At one point, Monnon and others reporting to him were outside around [[Local day/Legends|sunset]] after a severe windstorm, with Monnon noticing the rainbows reflecting on the landscape from the ice [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that were whipped into the air. On another [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Monnon and others explored flatlands north of the base, where they saw landforms caused by steam spraying out of underground springs near deep [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] sources. While exploring Hoth's southern hemisphere, Monnon and his group found a huge canyon that stretched nearly a thousand [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

Monnon heard of Hoth's [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] species before joining the Alliance, and when he and his group were away from Echo Base and sleeping in small thermal shelters, they could recognize the sounds of wampas crying out in the night. One night in their shelter, Monnon shared a story he had heard, where a group of failed Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] had set up a poaching operation where they guided [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]] to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] wampas. The fourth expedition resulted in the wampas killing all but two hunters, with the surviving ones killing each other instead of facing [[Torture/Legends|torture]] by the wampas. With the wampas' cries heard throughout that night as well, Monnon and the others were edgy and were glad to eventually return to Echo Base.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

===Finishing Echo Base===
{{Quote|Despite our full spectrum of defenses, we maintain our vigilance, waiting, always waiting, for the Empire to find us again.|Monnon, after Echo Base was completed|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />}}
[[File:CallumHollis.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Alliance soldiers defending Echo Base]]
Monnon and the Corps of Engineers assisted in modifying T-47 [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to function at peak performance for Hoth's worst cold weather. While the modifications took time, long-range scouts flew in a wide radius around Echo Base after the airspeeders functioned ideally. [[Echo Station/Legends|Echo Stations]] were established around Hoth to monitor meteor activity and to watch for any Imperial discovery.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

In addition to the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] and the physical defenses, 1,000 of the Alliance's [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] protected Echo Base in preparation for any Imperial attack.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> When Echo Base was finished, it had taken eighteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]] to carve the base and two more to fit the caverns with electronics, [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], and [[Life support/Legends|life support]].<ref name="DB" /> For new recruits, a map was published welcoming them to the base and illustrating important locations, with a welcome message from Monnon, who wished the soldiers luck and said if they had any questions, he could be found in the central command room.<ref name="Battles for Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''</ref> Monnon would proceed to publish a report on Hoth, including Echo Base's construction, at some point after the base was constructed and before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|less than one year later]].<ref name="FF13">{{FactFile|13|HOT 5-6|Hoth &ndash; Echo Base}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's not pretty, but it works.|Monnon's frequent quote about the in-progress Echo Base|<ref name="DB" />}}
[[File:CarlistRieekan-SWR.png|thumb|right|300px|Kem Monnon highly respected General Carlist Rieekan (pictured).]]
Kem Monnon did not like surprises, so his survey teams probed deeper into the ice caves than what ultimately became Echo Base's foundation for the sake of completeness. He was not disappointed, given the tauntauns' appearance, that their meat was not considered a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] source for himself and the engineers. Monnon's distaste for tauntauns was such that he punished a subordinate for insulting a coworker with tauntaun comparisons. He did not regard the initial Echo Base design during the cave expansion phase as elegant but considered it to be functional.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> In that aspect, Monnon and his crew would frequently remark: "it's not pretty, but it works."<ref name="DB" />

A few days after finishing his initial assignment, Monnon was fidgeting with boredom and found sitting around on alert immensely tiresome. He found Hoth's frozen scenery to have its own sense of beauty and the cleanliness of the planet refreshing after much of his previous Alliance service was in smelly [[Spice freighter/Legends|spice freighters]] or run-down, out-of-the-way bases. While Monnon doubted the authenticity of the wampa poaching story he had told the others he was in the shelter with, they were too afraid of the wampas' audible cries to speculate on the story and were relieved to be back to Echo Base with even the most tedious defense maintenance chores after that night.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

Monnon deeply respected General Rieekan and understood the latter's insistence on always maintaining a full defensive posture. He would not accept any of his subordinates having issues with the general and made sure all of them knew Rieekan's history. Monnon had [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and fair skin.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

==Skills and abilities==
Monnon was a capable engineer and respected leader.<ref name="DB" /> He had uncanny resourcefulness and an ability to motivate his crews despite Hoth's miserable living conditions. Under Monnon's leadership, Echo Base was opened up in record time. He also had enough knowledge of the planet Hoth and its species to write a detailed report.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

==Equipment==
Kem Monnon wore a [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|uniform]] similar to the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard's]] [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Note">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'' depicts Kem Monnon [[in-universe]] with artwork that {{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2021/05/an-empire-at-40-cloud-citys-sky-riders.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=AN 'EMPIRE' AT 40: CLOUD CITY'S SKY RIDERS!}} shows was concept art for the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard's]] [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. The latter group are shown by {{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#011: (Twin Pod) Cloud Car Pilot|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Twin_Pod_Cloud_Car_Pilot_Vintage_Collection_TVC_VC11.asp}} to have visually similar [[Clothing/Legends|uniforms]] in-universe.</ref> The uniform included a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] within a pouch.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kevin J. Anderson]] created Kem Monnon for the [[1995]] reference book ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''. The artwork used to represent Monnon was reused from<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]'s concept art of the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] pilots from the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2021/05/an-empire-at-40-cloud-citys-sky-riders.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=AN 'EMPIRE' AT 40: CLOUD CITY'S SKY RIDERS!}}</ref>
